scientific_integrity: Closed current formulas were known; the new mathematical content is the global monotone ratio and unique absolute-temperature inversion. All self-review are reported separately from an unperformed independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Applies to symmetric flat bosonic bath rates, global secular two-qubit exchange model, positive distinct Bohr frequencies, unequal site energies, finite positive coupling and fixed bath temperature ratio above unity; no claim for structured contacts/nonsecular dynamics.
title: A unique temperature-scale inversion of heat rectification in detuned coupled qubits
